messages.text: The filesystem differential case is already green; the manual Windows `cmd` probe was invalid because its quoting stripped the Nushell string delimiters, so it is not evidence against the implementation. One genuine failure remains in closure predicate evaluation, and I’m isolating it at the token/block boundary rather than masking it in `where`; the likely wrong direction would be special-casing even-number predicates instead of repairing closure parsing generally.
